title: 補償灌漿沉陷控制~Compensation grouting for settlement control
focus: 補償灌漿的變形回饋、注入效率與延遲~Compensation-grouting movement feedback, efficiency and delay
summary: 補償灌漿透過受控的地層變形降低隧道施工對資產的沉陷影響，其目標是控制差異變形而非追求最大抬升。本課把沉陷槽、注入效率、孔位誤差、有效應力及回饋延遲連成模型，再檢查結構角變形、曲率與停止注入後的殘餘反應。~Compensation grouting controls ground deformation to reduce settlement effects from tunnelling, targeting differential movement rather than maximum heave. The course connects settlement troughs, injection efficiency, bore position, effective stress and feedback delay, then evaluates structural distortion, curvature and residual movement after injection stops.

units.title: 沉陷槽形狀的機理與驗證~Settlement-trough shape mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 隧道引起的地表沉陷可用高斯形狀作第一近似，最大沉陷與槽寬共同決定影響範圍。補償灌漿的監測應涵蓋整個敏感資產而非只追最大值，因為槽邊坡度與曲率可能更影響建物；分層地盤或多隧道會偏離單一對稱槽。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。~A Gaussian shape approximates tunnel-induced surface settlement, with peak and width jointly defining the influence zone. Compensation monitoring should cover the sensitive asset rather than chase the peak alone because edge slope and curvature may govern building response. Layering and multiple tunnels can depart from one symmetric trough. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用跨越資產的測線擬合峰值與槽寬，保留未參與配適測點驗證，檢查不對稱及局部突變。變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。~Fit peak and width from survey lines spanning the asset, retaining unused points for validation and checking asymmetry and local discontinuities. The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points.
units.failure: 只控制中央沉陷可能讓槽邊差異變形增大，建物出現裂縫時總沉陷仍可能不大。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。~Controlling central settlement alone can increase edge distortion, allowing building cracking while total settlement remains modest. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.
units.misconception: 最大沉陷控制住就代表所有建物位置都安全。~Controlling peak settlement guarantees safety at every building location.
units.practice: 變形目標應由資產結構評估制定；監測及灌漿設計者共同確認控制區與獨立驗證點。高斯式是經驗形狀而非唯一機理，不能直接推算灌漿量；建物剛度、基礎及分層地盤均須另外考量。~The asset assessment defines movement targets; monitoring and grouting designers jointly establish control areas and independent validation points. The Gaussian expression is an empirical shape rather than a unique mechanism and does not directly determine grout volume; building stiffness, foundations and layering require separate consideration.

units.title: 注入抬升效率的機理與驗證~Injection-heave efficiency mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 注入漿液一部分填充孔隙或裂縫，另一部分造成土體位移，故注入體積不等於資產抬升體積。效率會隨既有灌漿、應力及排水改變，必須由已觀測反應校正；把所有留存量視為有效補償，可能導致過量注入與隆起。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。~Some grout fills voids or fractures while another part displaces soil, so injected volume does not equal asset-heave volume. Efficiency changes with prior treatment, stress and drainage and must be updated from observations. Treating all retained grout as useful compensation can cause excessive injection and unintended uplift. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將地表位移積分範圍、注入量與時間對齊，檢查資產外的變形是否被漏算，保留孔壓資料。效率估算應保留空間及時間範圍；地工設計者確認反應改變原因後，才調整補償方案。~Align the surface-integration area, injection volume and time, checking omitted movement outside the asset and retaining pore-pressure observations. Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation.
units.failure: 用固定效率追求補償可能在地盤變硬後造成過度隆起，或在漏失時持續注入而未達目標。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。~Using fixed efficiency can cause excessive heave after ground stiffens or continued injection without compensation when losses occur. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.
units.misconception: 注入一立方公尺漿液就一定有一立方公尺地表抬升。~One cubic metre of grout necessarily produces one cubic metre of surface heave.
units.practice: 效率估算應保留空間及時間範圍；地工設計者確認反應改變原因後，才調整補償方案。表觀效率可能受觀測區域及其他沉陷影響，不能當成固定材料常數；體積平衡還需考慮壓縮與漿液外逸。~Document the spatial and temporal bounds of efficiency estimates; the geotechnical designer confirms why response changed before revising compensation. Apparent efficiency depends on observation extent and concurrent settlement, so it is not a material constant; compression and grout escape also affect the balance.

units.title: 袖閥管定位的機理與驗證~Sleeve-pipe location mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 灌漿管位置控制注入與資產間的幾何關係，長孔小角度偏差可把有效區移到不同地層或接近既有設施。只知道孔口位置不足以定位各袖閥，必須建立全長軌跡，並與地下資產資料的不確定範圍一起比較。固定角誤差式不是全孔軌跡模型，實際曲線與孔口誤差會疊加；不可把名目深度當唯一空間座標。~Pipe location defines the geometry between injection and assets. Small angular errors over long bores can shift the effective zone into different strata or toward existing infrastructure. Collar position alone does not locate each sleeve port; full trajectories must be compared with the uncertainty envelope of buried assets. The fixed-angle expression is not a full trajectory model; curvature and collar errors accumulate, and nominal depth is not a unique spatial coordinate.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設管長L=20 m、方向誤差θ=1°，側向偏移δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For pipe length L=20 m and angular error θ=1°, lateral offset δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用核定孔斜量測及袖閥深度紀錄建立三維位置，核對管線調查精度，檢查注入反應是否符合所在層位。注入區與資產距離須以實測軌跡確認；接近敏感界面時由資產管理者及地工設計者共同核定。~Build three-dimensional port positions from approved deviation surveys and depth logs, checking utility-survey accuracy and whether response matches the intended stratum. Confirm injection-to-asset distance from measured trajectories; the asset owner and geotechnical designer jointly approve conditions near sensitive interfaces.
units.failure: 袖閥偏位可能把漿液送到資產下方的不利弱面，形成局部抬升或直接接觸地下設施。固定角誤差式不是全孔軌跡模型，實際曲線與孔口誤差會疊加；不可把名目深度當唯一空間座標。~A misplaced port can feed an adverse plane beneath an asset, producing localized heave or direct interaction with buried infrastructure. The fixed-angle expression is not a full trajectory model; curvature and collar errors accumulate, and nominal depth is not a unique spatial coordinate.
units.misconception: 孔口放樣正確就表示所有袖閥都在設計位置。~Correct collar setting-out proves every sleeve port is correctly positioned.
units.practice: 注入區與資產距離須以實測軌跡確認；接近敏感界面時由資產管理者及地工設計者共同核定。固定角誤差式不是全孔軌跡模型，實際曲線與孔口誤差會疊加；不可把名目深度當唯一空間座標。~Confirm injection-to-asset distance from measured trajectories; the asset owner and geotechnical designer jointly approve conditions near sensitive interfaces. The fixed-angle expression is not a full trajectory model; curvature and collar errors accumulate, and nominal depth is not a unique spatial coordinate.

units.anchor: 注入與有效應力~Injection and effective stress
units.title: 注入與有效應力的機理與驗證~Injection and effective stress mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 灌漿提高局部流體壓力時，土骨架有效應力可能下降，並觸發裂縫張開或土體位移。總應力也可能隨資產約束及灌漿反力改變，因此不能把泵端壓力直接代入孔壓；需要辨別管路損失、注入點與土中實際壓力。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。~Rising local fluid pressure can reduce skeleton effective stress and initiate fracture opening or movement. Total stress can also change through asset restraint and grout reaction, so pump pressure cannot be substituted directly for pore pressure. Distinguish line losses, injection-point pressure and the pressure actually measured in the soil. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設同一方向總應力σ=180 kPa、土中孔壓u=80 kPa，σ′=σ−u=100 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=180 kPa and soil pore pressure u=80 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=100 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 對照泵端及注入點壓力與鄰近孔壓計，量測管路損失，將資產位移及時間延遲一併記錄。壓力量測位置與損失修正須列於方案；地工及設備負責人共同確認資料意義後才調整控制邊界。~Compare pump and port pressures with nearby piezometers, assess line losses, and record asset movement and response delay together. State pressure locations and loss corrections in the plan; geotechnical and equipment leads confirm interpretation before control boundaries are changed.
units.failure: 把泵壓當土壓會錯估劈裂條件，可能持續提高注入而在遠端弱面形成非預期變形。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。~Treating pump pressure as soil pressure misstates fracture conditions and can encourage continued injection that moves an unintended distant weak plane. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings.
units.misconception: 泵端壓力就等於所有注入深度的實際孔隙水壓。~Pump pressure equals actual pore pressure at every injection depth.
units.practice: 壓力量測位置與損失修正須列於方案；地工及設備負責人共同確認資料意義後才調整控制邊界。此有效應力式不直接給劈裂壓力，還需最小主應力、抗拉及界面條件；教學壓力不是現場注入設定。~State pressure locations and loss corrections in the plan; geotechnical and equipment leads confirm interpretation before control boundaries are changed. Effective stress does not directly give fracture pressure, which also depends on minimum principal stress, tension and interfaces; these pressures are not field injection settings.

units.title: 回饋延遲的機理與驗證~Feedback delay mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 補償灌漿的控制迴路包含感測、傳輸、判讀與設備反應，每個環節的延遲會使已發生的位移晚到控制者眼前。若持續注入速度快於可觀察反應，容易超越目標；延遲應與地層本身的反應時間分開辨識。延遲相加假設環節串聯，並行處理需另建時間模型；二十秒不是允許延遲標準，也不取代資產反應分析。~The control loop includes sensing, transmission, interpretation and equipment response, each delaying the movement information reaching the controller. If injection continues faster than observable response, compensation may overshoot. System delay must be distinguished from the physical response time of the ground rather than combining them into one unexplained lag. Adding delays assumes serial stages; parallel processing needs a different timing model, and twenty seconds is neither an allowable delay nor a substitute for asset-response analysis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設感測5 s、傳輸3 s、判讀與反應12 s，總延遲τ=5+3+12=20 s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For sensing 5 s, transmission 3 s and interpretation-response 12 s, total delay τ=20 s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 使用共同時鐘追蹤注入事件與感測到達時間，模擬訊號中斷，確認遺失資料不會被當成零位移。控制計畫須設定資料新鮮度與失聯停留點；監測及施工負責人確認復原資料後才解除限制。~Use a common clock to trace injection events and data arrival, testing signal loss so missing data are not interpreted as zero movement. Control plans define data-freshness and communication-loss hold points; monitoring and construction leads confirm recovered data before restrictions are lifted.
units.failure: 資料延遲或凍結時仍持續控制，可能造成過度抬升；平滑濾波也會增加隱藏延遲。延遲相加假設環節串聯，並行處理需另建時間模型；二十秒不是允許延遲標準，也不取代資產反應分析。~Continued control during delayed or frozen data can overcompensate; smoothing filters can introduce additional hidden delay. Adding delays assumes serial stages; parallel processing needs a different timing model, and twenty seconds is neither an allowable delay nor a substitute for asset-response analysis.
units.misconception: 監測畫面仍有數字，就表示資料一定即時有效。~Numbers remaining on a monitoring display mean the data are current and valid.
units.practice: 控制計畫須設定資料新鮮度與失聯停留點；監測及施工負責人確認復原資料後才解除限制。延遲相加假設環節串聯，並行處理需另建時間模型；二十秒不是允許延遲標準，也不取代資產反應分析。~Control plans define data-freshness and communication-loss hold points; monitoring and construction leads confirm recovered data before restrictions are lifted. Adding delays assumes serial stages; parallel processing needs a different timing model, and twenty seconds is neither an allowable delay nor a substitute for asset-response analysis.

units.title: 建物角變形的機理與驗證~Building angular distortion mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 補償的目標通常是限制資產差異變位，單純追求回復地表標高可能反而造成局部反曲。兩點沉陷差可估平均角變形，但建物剛度及基礎連續性會改變力流；原有裂縫與脆性接頭需有個別的變形評估。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。~Compensation generally targets differential asset movement, and restoring surface elevation alone can produce adverse local reverse curvature. Two-point settlement difference estimates mean angular distortion, but building stiffness and foundation continuity change force paths. Existing cracks and brittle connections require their own movement assessment rather than a generic surface target. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設差異位移Δs=3 mm、測點距L=6 m=6000 mm，β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For differential movement Δs=3 mm over L=6 m=6000 mm, β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測資產本體而非只量附近地表，結合傾度與裂縫計分辨剛體轉動及真實畸變。資產變形控制區需由結構評估者核定；補償決策應同時檢查相鄰測點，不能只追單點目標。~Measure the asset itself rather than nearby ground alone, combining tilt and crack gauges to distinguish rigid-body rotation from actual distortion. The structural assessor approves asset-control zones; compensation decisions check neighbouring points rather than pursuing one isolated target.
units.failure: 過度補償一個測點可能讓鄰跨產生更大差異變位，總沉陷變小卻造成新的裂縫。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。~Overcompensating one point can increase differential movement in the next span, reducing total settlement while causing new cracks. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.
units.misconception: 只要把每個地表點抬回原高程，建物內力就會減少。~Returning every surface point to its original elevation necessarily reduces building forces.
units.practice: 資產變形控制區需由結構評估者核定；補償決策應同時檢查相鄰測點，不能只追單點目標。平均角變形不是通用損傷指標，需依跨距、剛度與既有狀態解釋；剛體傾斜應與構件彎曲分離。~The structural assessor approves asset-control zones; compensation decisions check neighbouring points rather than pursuing one isolated target. Mean angular distortion is not a universal damage indicator; interpret it with span, stiffness and existing condition, separating rigid tilt from member bending.

units.title: 效率隨歷程變化的機理與驗證~History-dependent efficiency mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 前次灌漿可能填滿可進入空隙或改變地層應力，使後續相同注入量產生不同位移。效率變化是地盤狀態更新的訊號，不能直接把較高效率當進度優勢；反應突然增強可能意味抬升更局部或注入路徑轉移。兩個效率必須採相同量測定義才可相除，否則倍率可能只是觀測範圍改變；它不直接給出下一輪施工參數。~Previous grouting may fill accessible voids or alter stress, changing movement from the same later injection volume. Efficiency change signals evolving ground state rather than an automatic productivity benefit. A stronger response can mean more localized heave or a shifted injection path, requiring renewed spatial interpretation. Efficiencies require identical measurement definitions before comparison; otherwise the ratio may reflect a changed observation area and does not prescribe the next operational settings.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設初期效率η₁=0.30、後期η₂=0.45，倍率η₂/η₁=1.5。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For initial efficiency η₁=0.30 and later η₂=0.45, response-efficiency ratio η₂/η₁=1.5. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以相同觀測範圍和時間窗比較各輪注入，檢查位移形狀是否改變，而非只計體積比。每輪回饋需保留歷史狀態與反應差異；設計者審查效率變化後更新模型，且保留舊版本供追溯。~Compare rounds over the same observation area and time window, examining movement shape as well as the volume ratio. Retain state history and response differences for each round; the designer updates the model after reviewing efficiency change and preserves earlier versions.
units.failure: 沿用早期效率可能讓後續補償過量，資產局部隆起或接縫反向開合而未被平均值識別。兩個效率必須採相同量測定義才可相除，否則倍率可能只是觀測範圍改變；它不直接給出下一輪施工參數。~Retaining early efficiency can overcompensate later rounds, creating local uplift or reversed joint movement hidden by averages. Efficiencies require identical measurement definitions before comparison; otherwise the ratio may reflect a changed observation area and does not prescribe the next operational settings.
units.misconception: 一次試驗得到的補償效率可以固定用到工程結束。~One trial compensation efficiency remains valid until project completion.
units.practice: 每輪回饋需保留歷史狀態與反應差異；設計者審查效率變化後更新模型，且保留舊版本供追溯。兩個效率必須採相同量測定義才可相除，否則倍率可能只是觀測範圍改變；它不直接給出下一輪施工參數。~Retain state history and response differences for each round; the designer updates the model after reviewing efficiency change and preserves earlier versions. Efficiencies require identical measurement definitions before comparison; otherwise the ratio may reflect a changed observation area and does not prescribe the next operational settings.

units.title: 結構曲率的機理與驗證~Structural curvature mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 連續建物或管線受到地盤變形時，曲率比單一斜率更直接反映彎曲需求。兩段轉角差除以距離可估局部曲率，資料解析度及測點間距卻會影響結果；把粗間距測點插值成平滑曲線，可能漏掉剛度突變處的集中彎曲。有限差分曲率是假設變形平滑的近似，接縫可集中轉動時不應當連續梁；材料應變還須乘中性軸距離。~For continuous buildings or pipes, curvature reflects bending demand more directly than one slope. Rotation difference over distance estimates local curvature, but resolution and spacing influence the result. Interpolating sparse points into a smooth curve can miss concentrated bending at stiffness transitions and produce false confidence in compatibility. Finite-difference curvature assumes smooth deformation; joints with concentrated rotation are not continuous beams, and material strain also requires distance from the neutral axis.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設轉角差Δθ=0.002 rad、間距L=4 m，κ≈Δθ/L=0.0005 m⁻¹。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For rotation difference Δθ=0.002 rad over L=4 m, κ≈Δθ/L=0.0005 m⁻¹. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 結合水準、傾度與結構斷面位置，檢查曲率估算對測點間距的敏感度，保留原始誤差。敏感接頭與剛度變化處應設專門測點；資產結構設計者核准曲率與應變的對應關係。~Combine levelling, tilt and section locations, checking sensitivity of curvature estimates to sensor spacing and retaining original uncertainty. Provide dedicated measurements at sensitive joints and stiffness changes; the asset structural designer approves the relation between curvature and strain.
units.failure: 測點太疏可能漏掉局部彎曲，脆性管線或既有接頭先損傷，而平均沉陷仍在目標內。有限差分曲率是假設變形平滑的近似，接縫可集中轉動時不應當連續梁；材料應變還須乘中性軸距離。~Sparse points can miss local bending that damages brittle utilities or existing joints while mean settlement stays within target. Finite-difference curvature assumes smooth deformation; joints with concentrated rotation are not continuous beams, and material strain also requires distance from the neutral axis.
units.misconception: 兩點傾斜角很小，就能保證中間沒有局部高曲率。~A small two-point tilt guarantees no high curvature between them.
units.practice: 敏感接頭與剛度變化處應設專門測點；資產結構設計者核准曲率與應變的對應關係。有限差分曲率是假設變形平滑的近似，接縫可集中轉動時不應當連續梁；材料應變還須乘中性軸距離。~Provide dedicated measurements at sensitive joints and stiffness changes; the asset structural designer approves the relation between curvature and strain. Finite-difference curvature assumes smooth deformation; joints with concentrated rotation are not continuous beams, and material strain also requires distance from the neutral axis.

units.anchor: 小訊號反應模型~Small-signal response model
units.title: 小訊號反應模型的機理與驗證~Small-signal response model mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 以既有小幅注入與量測可建立局部線性增益，供比較控制敏感度，但地盤劈裂與接觸開閉使系統本質非線性。模型只能在相近狀態及小增量內使用，不能從一次反應直接推算大體積注入，更不能把理論控制值當作現場施作指令。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。~Small observed injections can establish a local linear gain for comparing control sensitivity, but fracture growth and opening or closing contact make the ground nonlinear. The model applies only near the calibrated state and for small increments. One response cannot justify large-volume extrapolation or turn a theoretical control quantity into field instructions. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model.
units.model: 原創教學假設：純合成控制示例假設局部增益g=2 mm/L、微小輸入ΔV=0.5 L，預測Δs=gΔV=1 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: In a purely synthetic control example, local gain g=2 mm/L and small input ΔV=0.5 L give Δs=gΔV=1 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用未參與辨識的小幅資料檢查增益，對比位置、時間及孔壓，確認反應沒有改變機制。現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。~Check the gain against small observations excluded from identification, comparing location, timing and pore pressure to confirm the mechanism remains unchanged. Field parameters follow approved trials and asset constraints; the geotechnical designer confirms the control model range and failure hold points.
units.failure: 把線性增益外推至大注入量，可能因新裂縫或局部抬升而產生遠超預期的變形。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。~Extrapolating linear gain to large injection can activate new fractures or localized heave and produce movements far beyond prediction. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model.
units.misconception: 一次注入得到的線性增益可精確預測任何後續用量。~A linear gain from one injection predicts any later volume exactly.
units.practice: 現場參數需由核定試驗與資產限制決定；控制模型由地工設計者確認適用區間及失效停留點。算例數字完全合成，只用來說明增益與輸入單位，不是推薦注入量；一旦狀態改變，需重新辨識或改採非線性模型。~Field parameters follow approved trials and asset constraints; the geotechnical designer confirms the control model range and failure hold points. The numbers are wholly synthetic and illustrate gain and input units rather than recommended injection quantity; changed state requires re-identification or a nonlinear model.

units.title: 停注後反應的機理與驗證~Post-injection response mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 停止注入後，地盤仍可能因孔壓消散、漿材固化及隧道持續開挖而移動，因此控制不應在閥門關閉時結束。殘餘位移與時間的關係有助分辨短時回彈及長期沉陷，但需扣除其他施工事件並保持監測基準不變。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。~Movement can continue after injection through pore-pressure dissipation, curing and ongoing tunnelling, so control should not end when a valve closes. Residual movement over time helps distinguish rebound from longer-term settlement, but other construction events must be separated and the monitoring datum kept consistent. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設停注後位移由1.0 mm至1.4 mm、間隔4 day，平均變化率v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For post-injection movement from 1.0 mm to 1.4 mm over four days, mean rate v=0.4/4=0.1 mm/day. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 持續記錄位移、孔壓及隧道進度，檢查停止注入後的相位及反向移動，保留資料到核定穩定條件。交接需明定停止注入後的監測責任與結案條件；資產及地工負責人共同確認殘餘反應。~Continue movement, pore-pressure and tunnel-progress records, checking phase and reversal after injection until approved stabilization conditions are demonstrated. Handover defines post-injection monitoring responsibility and closure conditions; asset and geotechnical leads jointly confirm residual response.
units.failure: 太早結束監測會漏掉延遲抬升或回沉，資產可能在施工團隊撤離後才出現接縫問題。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。~Ending monitoring early misses delayed uplift or renewed settlement, leaving asset joints to develop problems after the construction team leaves. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.
units.misconception: 停止灌漿後，地盤位移也會立即完全停止。~Ground movement stops completely as soon as grouting stops.
units.practice: 交接需明定停止注入後的監測責任與結案條件；資產及地工負責人共同確認殘餘反應。四天平均率不代表最終沉陷或峰值速率，且需要固定位置與方向；本例不能取代專案監測終止判據。~Handover defines post-injection monitoring responsibility and closure conditions; asset and geotechnical leads jointly confirm residual response. A four-day mean does not establish final settlement or peak rate and requires fixed location and direction; it cannot replace project monitoring closure criteria.

example: 原創教學例：假設高斯沉陷槽smax=20 mm、寬度參數i=10 m，在x=10 m位置，s=20 exp(−10²/(2×10²))=12.13 mm。若只增加峰值10%至22 mm，槽寬不變，同位置沉陷為13.34 mm，也增加10%。這個結果描述固定形狀的沉陷場，不是所需灌漿量；實際建物剛度、注入效率、孔位與反應延遲會影響補償。工程師應檢查全資產角變形與曲率，並以獨立測點驗證槽形，不能只把單點抬回原位當成完成。~Original teaching example: assume a Gaussian trough with smax=20 mm and width parameter i=10 m. At x=10 m, s=20 exp(−10²/(2×10²))=12.13 mm. Increase only the peak by 10% to 22 mm while keeping width fixed: movement at the same position becomes 13.34 mm, also up 10%. This describes a fixed-shape settlement field, not required grout quantity. Building stiffness, injection efficiency, port position and response delay affect actual compensation. Check distortion and curvature across the whole asset and validate trough shape at independent points rather than defining completion by restoring one point alone.
history: 補償灌漿透過受控的地層變形降低隧道施工對資產的沉陷影響，其目標是控制差異變形而非追求最大抬升。本課把沉陷槽、注入效率、孔位誤差、有效應力及回饋延遲連成模型，再檢查結構角變形、曲率與停止注入後的殘餘反應。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Compensation grouting controls ground deformation to reduce settlement effects from tunnelling, targeting differential movement rather than maximum heave. The course connects settlement troughs, injection efficiency, bore position, effective stress and feedback delay, then evaluates structural distortion, curvature and residual movement after injection stops. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
facts: 合成教學假設：假設smax=20 mm、槽寬參數i=10 m、位置x=10 m，s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For smax=20 mm, trough parameter i=10 m and x=10 m, s=smax exp[−x²/(2i²)]=12.1 mm
合成教學假設：假設估算抬升體積Vh=0.6 m³、注入Vg=2 m³，表觀效率η=Vh/Vg=0.30~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For inferred heave volume Vh=0.6 m³ and injection Vg=2 m³, apparent efficiency η=Vh/Vg=0.30
合成教學假設：假設管長L=20 m、方向誤差θ=1°，側向偏移δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For pipe length L=20 m and angular error θ=1°, lateral offset δ=Lsinθ=0.349 m
合成教學假設：假設同一方向總應力σ=180 kPa、土中孔壓u=80 kPa，σ′=σ−u=100 kPa~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For total stress σ=180 kPa and soil pore pressure u=80 kPa in the same direction, σ′=σ−u=100 kPa
合成教學假設：假設感測5 s、傳輸3 s、判讀與反應12 s，總延遲τ=5+3+12=20 s~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For sensing 5 s, transmission 3 s and interpretation-response 12 s, total delay τ=20 s
合成教學假設：假設差異位移Δs=3 mm、測點距L=6 m=6000 mm，β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For differential movement Δs=3 mm over L=6 m=6000 mm, β=Δs/L=0.0005 rad
